Descriptions

1 line

Solarity AI builds AI self-improvement apps and the tools that let its small team ship them fast.

Short description

Solarity AI LLC, based in Irving, Texas, builds AI-powered self-improvement apps: Looks Max, IQ Max, Sleep Max, and Fitness Max (listed in the app stores as Only Fitness), all on iOS and Android. Building them shaped 3 web apps for teams that build mobile products: Engineering Max, Management Max, and Marketing Max. Founder: Ata Turhan.

Using the name and images

  • Write the name as Solarity AI: 2 words, with “AI” in capitals.
  • Use the sun mark as supplied. Don’t recolor, stretch, or redraw it.
  • Fitness Max appears in the app stores as Only Fitness; name both when you link to its listing.
  • Describe products with the facts on this site. Ask before stating numbers, users, or results.
